attempts.summary: Built an active-active redundant uplink between node1 and node2 by bonding their two independent point-to-point links (eth1+eth2, mode balance-rr) into bond0, and routed the two private networks (node1-eth3 to node3 at 192.168.10.0/24, node2-eth3 to node4 at 192.168.20.0/24) over that bond via static routes. Persisted the config (systemd service on node1/node2, NetworkManager profile on node3/node4). Verified both links carry live traffic simultaneously, verified node3-node4 connectivity survives either link going down (0% loss on the surviving link), and completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all 4 nodes with boot-identity proof and post-restart recovery verification.
